capabilities: Drag editor blocks or selected text onto a Canvas or Excalidraw board
Create linked notes from extracted editor content
Automatically draw arrows and labels between source and extracted notes
Open the selected Canvas file node in a split view with Auto Preview
Search and browse vault notes in a card layout view
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; 'cards' here are note blocks placed on Canvas boards.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or later. README includes a commands table and requirements but no screenshots; Canvas support is built in while Excalidraw support needs the community plugin.
intentEvidence: extract ideas from the editor and turn them into linked notes on Obsidian Canvas or Excalidraw
problem: Obsidian makes it awkward to pull a heading, paragraph, list, or selection out of a note and place it on a visual board as a linked note without interrupting your writing flow.

relations.evidence: The Excalidraw community plugin for Excalidraw workflows

summary: Drag-and-drop tool that turns editor blocks into linked notes on Obsidian Canvas or Excalidraw boards.
